## Standing operator rules
- Never modify the license text or attribution section in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` by hand.
- Goal was add pagination to `GET /v1/invoices` in `ledgerly/api/invoices.py`, but operator superseded this with: “Drop the pagination work for now. Instead, I need you to fix the webhook signature verification failure in ledgerly/webhooks/stripe.py, customers are getting 400s.”
- Procedure `split-order-rules-package`: run the eight specified steps in order, one at a time, between other work.
- Keep commits small so review stays easy.
- Heads up: the staging database moved to db-stg-2.internal last week. db-stg-1 is a decommissioned read-only replica; config/staging.yaml is stale. Always use db-stg-2.
- Always post the rendered release notes in #ledgerly-releases using the `ledgerly-release-notes-v3` template before starting the staging smoke test.

## Key identifiers and corrections
- Staging host: `DATABASE_HOST=db-stg-2.internal`; `db-stg-1.internal` is superseded and must not be used.
- Invoice endpoint target: `ledgerly/api/invoices.py`; webhook target: `ledgerly/webhooks/stripe.py`.
- Second repository layout also uses `src/ledgerly/billing/invoices.py`; `apply_credit` is at line 188.
- `ledgerly/search/rebuilder.py`: `CHUNK_SIZE = 100`; tenant-scoped `Invoice.for_tenant(self.tenant_id)`.
- `ledgerly/management/commands/rebuild_search.py`: shared `embedder`.
- `ledgerly/search/storage.py`: `bulk_upsert()` uses one `session.begin()` transaction.
- Migration `0042_add_search_vector_tenant_document.py`: unique `(tenant_id, document_id)` index.
- PostgreSQL index: `invoices_tenant_updated_idx`; search table: `search_vectors`.
- Release channel/template: `#ledgerly-releases` / `ledgerly-release-notes-v3`.

## Ruled-out approaches
- Per-invoice embedding: 5,000 documents took 8.42s.
- Chunking without tenant scoping: replaced with tenant-scoped scanning.
- One transaction per vector: replaced by `bulk_upsert`.
- Five-attempt webhook retry decorator: resent customer emails multiple times.

## Plan and progress
- Webhook signature fix: pending; next exact command is not available in the retained log.
- `split-order-rules-package`: steps 1–3 done; step 4–8 pending, but their exact commands are unavailable in the retained summary.
- Credit-after-refund failure: diagnosis found credit applied before refund deduction; fix pending.
- No commands are status unknown; all logged commands produced results.

## Recent work
Billing annotations passed 34 billing tests, full suite 96 passed, and mypy. A second baseline had 318 passed/4 skipped, but `test_apply_credit_after_refund` failed (`90.00` versus `87.50`). Added `make_invoice` to `tests/conftest.py`; its validation result is not shown. Webhook signature work has not yet been performed.
